hazards.evidence: Multiple pairs of shoes/sandals and a pile of folded linens/clothes stacked on and around a small wooden stool on the floor at the lower-left, narrowing and cluttering the path a walker user would take through the room.
A shower seat is present, but no handheld showerhead, hose, or shower controls are visible within reach of the seated bather for safe seated rinsing.
Strong direct sunlight creates a bright glare patch with adjacent deep shadow across the wall and floor, producing high contrast that can obscure floor-level obstacles for an older adult.
